This plot is small, only a small piece, and it is not mine — I rent it. I do not want to spend much cash on land that is not mine. Beans do not need much fertilizer like maize does, my father always said beans feed themselves from the soil. I will put some manure from my few animals, use my own seed I saved from last year, and weed by hand with my wife. No chemical fertilizer this year, no spray, no hired hands — cash is too tight and the rain should come as it always does.
